verses.transliteration: ahorātrādikaṃ nāsti snānadhyānādikaṃ nahi | bhrāntirabhrāntirnāstyeva nāstyanātmeti niścinu
verses.translation: No day and night and the like; no bathing, meditation and the like; neither delusion nor non-delusion exists; be certain there is no non-Self.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No day and night and the like; no bathing, ध्यान/उपासना and the like; neither delusion nor non-delusion exists; be certain there is no non-Self.।

verses.sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रं पुराणं च कार्यं कारणमीश्वरः । लोको भूतं जनस्त्वैक्यं सर्वं मिथ्या न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vedaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ ca kāryaṃ kāraṇamīśvaraḥ | loko bhūtaṃ janastvaikyaṃ sarvaṃ mithyā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Veda, scripture, Purana, effect, cause, Lord, world, beings, people, unity — all is false; no doubt.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Veda, scripture, Purana, effect, cause, Lord, world, beings, people, unity — all is false; no doubt.।

verses.sanskrit: बन्धो मोक्षः सुखं दुःखं ध्यानं चित्तं सुरासुराः । गौणं मुख्यं परं चान्यत्सर्वं मिथ्या न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bandho mokṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dhyānaṃ cittaṃ surāsurāḥ | gauṇaṃ mukhyaṃ paraṃ cānyatsarvaṃ mithyā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Bondage, liberation, pleasure, pain, meditation, mind, gods and demons, secondary, primary, supreme and other — all is false; no doubt.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Bondage, मोक्ष, pleasure, pain, ध्यान/उपासना, mind, gods and demons, secondary, primary, supreme and other — all is false; no doubt.।

verses.sanskrit: वाचा वदति यत्किञ्चित्सङ्कल्पैः कल्प्यते च यत् । मनसा चिन्त्यते यद्यत्सर्वं मिथ्या न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vācā vadati yatkiñcitsaṅkalpaiḥ kalpyate ca yat | manasā cintyate yadyatsarvaṃ mithyā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever is said by speech, whatever is imagined by intentions, whatever is thought by mind — all is false; no doubt.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is कहा by speech, whatever is imagined by intentions, whatever is thought by mind — all is false; no doubt.।

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्या निश्चीयते किञ्चिच्चित्ते निश्चीयते क्वचित् । शास्त्रैः प्रपञ्च्यते यद्यन्नेत्रेणैव निरीक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: buddhyā niścīyate kiñciccitte niścīyate kvacit | śāstraiḥ prapañcyate yadyannetreṇaiva nirīkṣyate
verses.translation: Whatever is determined by intellect, determined anywhere in the mind, extended by scriptures, seen by the eye,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is determined by intellect, determined anywhere in मन, extended by scriptures, seen by the eye,।

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्राभ्यां श्रूयते यद्यदन्यत्सद्भावमेव च । नेत्रं श्रोत्रं गात्रमेव मिथ्येति च सुनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: śrotrābhyāṃ śrūyate yadyadanyatsadbhāvameva ca | netraṃ śrotraṃ gātrameva mithyeti ca suniścitam
verses.translation: whatever is heard by the ears, and any other existing thing — eye, ear, body are firmly determined as false.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is heard by the ears, and any other existing thing — eye, ear, body are firmly determined as false.।

verses.sanskrit: इदमित्येव निर्दिष्टमयमित्येव कल्प्यते । त्वमहं तदिदं सोऽहमन्यत्सद्भावमेव च
verses.transliteration: idamityeva nirdiṣṭamayamityeva kalpyate | tvamahaṃ tadidaṃ so'hamanyatsadbhāvameva ca
verses.translation: "This" is what is pointed to; "this" is what is imagined; you, I, that, this, he, and any other existing thing —
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This" is what is pointed to; "this" is what is imagined; you, I, that, this, he, and any other existing thing —।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यत्सम्भाव्यते लोके सर्वसङ्कल्पसम्भ्रमः । सर्वाध्यासं सर्वगोप्यं सर्वभोगप्रभेदकम्
verses.transliteration: yadyatsambhāvyate loke sarvasaṅkalpasambhramaḥ | sarvādhyāsaṃ sarvagopyaṃ sarvabhogaprabhedakam
verses.translation: whatever is imagined in the world, the confusion of all intention, all superimposition, all secrets, all differences of enjoyment,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is imagined in the world, the confusion of all intention, all superimposition, all secrets, all differences of enjoyment,।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदोषप्रभेदाच्च नास्त्यनात्मेति निश्चिनु । मदीयं च त्वदीयं च ममेति च तवेति च
verses.transliteration: sarvadoṣaprabhedācca nāstyanātmeti niścinu | madīyaṃ ca tvadīyaṃ ca mameti ca taveti ca
verses.translation: and from the distinction of all faults, be certain there is no non-Self. Mine and yours, "of me" and "of you,"
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: and from the distinction of all faults, be certain there is no non-Self. Mine and yours, "of me" and "of you,।

verses.sanskrit: मह्यं तुभ्यं मयेत्यादि तत्सर्वं वितथं भवेत् । रक्षको विष्णुरित्यादि ब्रह्मा सृष्टेस्तु कारणम्
verses.transliteration: mahyaṃ tubhyaṃ mayetyādi tatsarvaṃ vitathaṃ bhavet | rakṣako viṣṇurityādi brahmā sṛṣṭestu kāraṇam
verses.translation: "for me," "for you," "by me" and the like — all that is false. Vishnu is the protector, Brahma is the cause of creation,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: for me," "for you," "by me" and the like — all that is false. Vishnu is the protector, Brahma is the cause of creation,।

verses.sanskrit: संहारे रुद्र इत्येवं सर्वं मिथ्येति निश्चिनु । स्नानं जपस्तपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवपूजनम्
verses.transliteration: saṃhāre rudra ityevaṃ sarvaṃ mithyeti niścinu | snānaṃ japastapo homaḥ svādhyāyo devapūjanam
verses.translation: Rudra of dissolution — be certain all this is false. Bathing, repetition, austerity, oblation, self-study, worship of gods,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Rudra of dissolution — be certain all this is false. Bathing, repetition, तपस्या, oblation, self-study, worship of gods,।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रं तन्त्रं च सत्सङ्गो गुणदोषविजृम्भणम् । अन्तःकरणसद्भाव अविद्याश्च सम्भवः
verses.transliteration: mantraṃ tantraṃ ca satsaṅgo guṇadoṣavijṛmbhaṇam | antaḥkaraṇasadbhāva avidyāśca sambhavaḥ
verses.translation: mantra, tantra, company of the good, the display of qualities and faults, the existence of the inner instrument and the rise of ignorance,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: mantra, tantra, company of the good, the display of qualities and faults, the existence of the inner instrument and the rise of अविद्या,।

verses.sanskrit: अनेककोटिब्रह्माण्डं सर्वं मिथ्येति निश्चिनु । सर्वदेशिकवाक्योक्तिर्येन केनापि निश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: anekakoṭibrahmāṇḍaṃ sarvaṃ mithyeti niścinu | sarvadeśikavākyoktiryena kenāpi niścitam
verses.translation: many crores of universes — be certain all is false. The utterances of all teachers, whatever has been determined by anyone,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: many crores of universes — be certain all is false. The utterances of all teachers, whatever has been determined by anyone,।

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यते जगति यद्यद्यद्यज्जगति वीक्ष्यते । वर्तते जगति यद्यत्सर्वं मिथ्येति निश्चिनु
verses.transliteration: dṛśyate jagati yadyadyadyajjagati vīkṣyate | vartate jagati yadyatsarvaṃ mithyeti niścinu
verses.translation: whatever is seen in the world, whatever is looked at in the world, whatever exists in the world — be certain all is false.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is seen in the world, whatever is looked at in the world, whatever exists in the world — be certain all is false.।

verses.sanskrit: येन केनाक्षरेणोक्तं येन केन विनिश्चितम् । येन केनापि गदितं येन केनापि मोदितम्
verses.transliteration: yena kenākṣareṇoktaṃ yena kena viniścitam | yena kenāpi gaditaṃ yena kenāpi moditam
verses.translation: Whatever is said by any letter, determined by anyone, spoken by anyone, rejoiced in by anyone,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is कहा by any letter, determined by anyone, spoken by anyone, rejoiced in by anyone,।

verses.sanskrit: येन केनापि यद्दत्तं येन केनापि यत्कृतम् । यत्र यत्र शुभं कर्म यत्र यत्र च दुष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yena kenāpi yaddattaṃ yena kenāpi yatkṛtam | yatra yatra śubhaṃ karma yatra yatra ca duṣkṛtam
verses.translation: whatever given by anyone, done by anyone, wherever good action, wherever evil action,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever given by anyone, done by anyone, wherever good action, wherever evil action,।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यत्करोषि सत्येन सर्वं मिथ्येति निश्चिनु । त्वमेव परमात्मासि त्वमेव परमो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: yadyatkaroṣi satyena sarvaṃ mithyeti niścinu | tvameva paramātmāsi tvameva paramo guruḥ
verses.translation: whatever you do with truth — be certain all is false. You alone are the Supreme Self; you alone are the supreme teacher.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever you do with truth — be certain all is false. You alone are परमात्मा; you alone are the supreme teacher.।

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेवाकाशरूपोऽसि साक्षिहीनोऽसि सर्वदा । त्वमेव सर्वभावोऽसि त्वं ब्रह्मासि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tvamevākāśarūpo'si sākṣihīno'si sarvadā | tvameva sarvabhāvo'si tvaṃ brahmāsi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: You alone are of the form of space; you are ever without witness; you alone are all being; you are Brahman; no doubt.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You alone are of the form of space; you are ever without witness; you alone are all being; you are परब्रह्म; no doubt.।

verses.sanskrit: कालहीनोऽसि कालोऽसि सदा ब्रह्मासि चिद्घनः । सर्वतः स्वस्वरूपोऽसि चैतन्यघनवानसि
verses.transliteration: kālahīno'si kālo'si sadā brahmāsi cidghanaḥ | sarvataḥ svasvarūpo'si caitanyaghanavānasi
verses.translation: You are free of time, you are time; you are always Brahman, a mass of consciousness; you are of your own nature everywhere; you are a mass of consciousness.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are free of time, you are time; you are always परब्रह्म, a mass of चैतन्य; you are of your own nature everywhere; you are a mass of चैतन्य.।

verses.sanskrit: सत्योऽसि सिद्धोऽसि सनातनोऽसि मुक्तोऽसि मोक्षोऽसि मुदामृतोऽसि । देवोऽसि शान्तोऽसि निरामयोऽसि ब्रह्मासि पूर्णोऽसि परात्परोऽसि
verses.transliteration: satyo'si siddho'si sanātano'si mukto'si mokṣo'si mudāmṛto'si | devo'si śānto'si nirāmayo'si brahmāsi pūrṇo'si parātparo'si
verses.translation: You are truth, you are perfected, you are eternal, you are free, you are liberation, you are joy and nectar; you are god, you are peaceful, you are without disease; you are Brahman, you are full, you are higher than the highest.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are truth, you are perfected, you are eternal, you are free, you are मोक्ष, you are joy and nectar; you are god, you are peaceful, you are without disease; you are परब्रह्म, you are full, you are higher than the highest.।

verses.sanskrit: समोऽसि सच्चापि सनातनोऽसि सत्यादिवाक्यैः प्रतिबोधितोऽसि । सर्वाङ्गहीनोऽसि सदा स्थितोऽसि ब्रह्मेन्द्ररुद्रादिविभावितोऽसि
verses.transliteration: samo'si saccāpi sanātano'si satyādivākyaiḥ pratibodhito'si | sarvāṅgahīno'si sadā sthito'si brahmendrarudrādivibhāvito'si
verses.translation: You are even, you are being, you are eternal, you are awakened by sayings like "truth"; you are devoid of all limbs, you are ever established; you are contemplated by Brahma, Indra, Rudra and the rest.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are even, you are being, you are eternal, you are awakened by sayings like "truth"; you are devoid of all limbs, you are ever established; you are contemplated by Brahma, Indra, Rudra and the rest.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वप्रपञ्चभ्रमवर्जितोऽसि सर्वेषु भूतेषु च भासितोऽसि । सर्वत्र सङ्कल्पविवर्जितोऽसि सर्वागमान्तार्थविभावितोऽसि
verses.transliteration: sarvaprapañcabhramavarjito'si sarveṣu bhūteṣu ca bhāsito'si | sarvatra saṅkalpavivarjito'si sarvāgamāntārthavibhāvito'si
verses.translation: You are free of the delusion of all the world; you shine in all beings; you are free of intention everywhere; you are contemplated as the final meaning of all scriptures.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are free of the delusion of all the world; you shine in all beings; you are free of intention everywhere; you are contemplated as the final meaning of all scriptures.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र सन्तोषसुखासनोऽसि सर्वत्र गत्यादिविवर्जितोऽसि । सर्वत्र लक्ष्यादिविवर्जितोऽसि ध्यातोऽसि विष्ण्वादिसुरैरजस्रम्
verses.transliteration: sarvatra santoṣasukhāsano'si sarvatra gatyādivivarjito'si | sarvatra lakṣyādivivarjito'si dhyāto'si viṣṇvādisurairajasram
verses.translation: You are everywhere at ease in contentment; you are everywhere free of going and the like; you are everywhere free of aim and the like; you are constantly meditated on by Vishnu and the other gods.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are everywhere at ease in contentment; you are everywhere free of going and the like; you are everywhere free of aim and the like; you are constantly meditated on by Vishnu and the other gods.।

verses.sanskrit: चिदाकारस्वरूपोऽसि चिन्मात्रोऽसि निरङ्कुशः । आत्मन्येव स्थितोऽसि त्वं सर्वशून्योऽसि निर्गुणः
verses.transliteration: cidākārasvarūpo'si cinmātro'si niraṅkuśaḥ | ātmanyeva sthito'si tvaṃ sarvaśūnyo'si nirguṇaḥ
verses.translation: You are of the nature of the form of consciousness; you are mere consciousness, unchecked; you abide in the Self alone; you are void of all, attributeless.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are of the nature of the form of चैतन्य; you are mere चैतन्य, unchecked; you abide in आत्मा alone; you are void of all, attributeless.।

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दोऽसि परोऽसि त्वमेक एवाद्वितीयकः । चिद्घनानन्दरूपोऽसि परिपूर्णस्वरूपकः
verses.transliteration: ānando'si paro'si tvameka evādvitīyakaḥ | cidghanānandarūpo'si paripūrṇasvarūpakaḥ
verses.translation: You are bliss, you are the supreme; you are one alone without a second; you are of the form of a mass of consciousness-bliss; you are of fully complete nature.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are bliss, you are the supreme; you are one alone without a second; you are of the form of a mass of चैतन्य-bliss; you are of fully complete nature.।

verses.sanskrit: सदसि त्वमसि ज्ञोऽसि सोऽसि जानासि वीक्षसि । सच्चिदानन्दरूपोऽसि वासुदेवोऽसि वै प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sadasi tvamasi jño'si so'si jānāsi vīkṣasi | saccidānandarūpo'si vāsudevo'si vai prabhuḥ
verses.translation: You are being, you are "thou," you are the knower, you are "he"; you know, you see; you are of the form of being-consciousness-bliss; you are Vasudeva, the lord.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are being, you are "thou," you are the knower, you are "he"; you know, you see; you are of the form of being-चैतन्य-bliss; you are Vasudeva, the lord.।

verses.sanskrit: अमृतोऽसि विभुश्चासि चञ्चलो ह्यचलो ह्यसि । सर्वोऽसि सर्वहीनोऽसि शान्ताशान्तविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: amṛto'si vibhuścāsi cañcalo hyacalo hyasi | sarvo'si sarvahīno'si śāntāśāntavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: You are immortal, you are all-pervading; you are both moving and unmoving; you are all, you are devoid of all; free of peaceful and unpeaceful.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are immortal, you are all-pervading; you are both moving and unmoving; you are all, you are devoid of all; free of peaceful and unpeaceful.।

verses.sanskrit: सत्तामात्रप्रकाशोऽसि सत्तासामान्यको ह्यसि । नित्यसिद्धिस्वरूपोऽसि सर्वसिद्धिविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: sattāmātraprakāśo'si sattāsāmānyako hyasi | nityasiddhisvarūpo'si sarvasiddhivivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: You are the light of mere being; you are common being; you are of the nature of eternal accomplishment; free of all accomplishments.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are the light of mere being; you are common being; you are of the nature of eternal accomplishment; free of all accomplishments.।

verses.sanskrit: ईषन्मात्रविशून्योऽसि अणुमात्रविवर्जितः । अस्तित्ववर्जितोऽसि त्वं नास्तित्वादिविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: īṣanmātraviśūnyo'si aṇumātravivarjitaḥ | astitvavarjito'si tvaṃ nāstitvādivivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: You are void of even a trace; free of even an atom; you are free of existence; free of non-existence and the like.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are void of even a trace; free of even an atom; you are free of existence; free of non-existence and the like.।

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्यलक्षणहीनोऽसि निर्विकारो निरामयः । सर्वनादान्तरोऽसि त्वं कलाकाष्ठाविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: lakṣyalakṣaṇahīno'si nirvikāro nirāmayaḥ | sarvanādāntaro'si tvaṃ kalākāṣṭhāvivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: You are devoid of aim and mark, changeless, free of disease; you are inside all nada; free of parts and moments.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are devoid of aim and mark, changeless, free of disease; you are inside all nada; free of parts and moments.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशहीनोऽसि स्वस्वरूपं प्रपश्यसि । स्वस्वरूपावशेषोऽसि स्वानन्दाब्धौ निमज्जसि
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇvīśahīno'si svasvarūpaṃ prapaśyasi | svasvarūpāvaśeṣo'si svānandābdhau nimajjasi
verses.translation: You are devoid of Brahma, Vishnu, Ishvara; you behold your own nature; you remain as your own nature; you plunge into the ocean of your own bliss.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are devoid of Brahma, Vishnu, Ishvara; you behold your own nature; you remain as your own nature; you plunge into the ocean of your own bliss.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मराज्ये स्वमेवासि स्वयम्भावविवर्जितः । शिष्टपूर्णस्वरूपोऽसि स्वस्मात्किञ्चिन्न पश्यसि
verses.transliteration: svātmarājye svamevāsi svayambhāvavivarjitaḥ | śiṣṭapūrṇasvarūpo'si svasmātkiñcinna paśyasi
verses.translation: In the kingdom of your own Self you are only yourself, free of self-being; you are of the nature of the remaining fullness; you see nothing apart from yourself.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: In the kingdom of your own Self you are only yourself, free of self-being; you are of the nature of the remaining fullness; you see nothing apart from yourself.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्वरूपान्न चलसि स्वस्वरूपेण जृम्भसि । स्वस्वरूपादनन्योऽसि ह्यहमेवासि निश्चिनु
verses.transliteration: svasvarūpānna calasi svasvarūpeṇa jṛmbhasi | svasvarūpādananyo'si hyahamevāsi niścinu
verses.translation: You do not move from your own nature; you expand by your own nature; you are not other than your own nature; be certain that you are I alone.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You do not move from your own nature; you expand by your own nature; you are not other than your own nature; be certain that you are I alone.।

verses.sanskrit: इदं प्रपञ्चं यत्किञ्चिद्यद्यज्जगति विद्यते । दृश्यरूपं च दृग्रूपं सर्वं शशविषाणवत्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ prapañcaṃ yatkiñcidyadyajjagati vidyate | dṛśyarūpaṃ ca dṛgrūpaṃ sarvaṃ śaśaviṣāṇavat
verses.translation: Whatever this world is, whatever exists in the world, of the form of the seen and the form of seeing, all is like a hare's horn.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever this world is, whatever exists in the world, of the form of the seen and the form of seeing, all is like a hare's horn.।

verses.sanskrit: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च । अहङ्कारश्च तेजश्च लोकं भुवनमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca | ahaṅkāraśca tejaśca lokaṃ bhuvanamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Earth, water, fire, wind, space, mind and intellect, ego, light, the world and the orb of the worlds,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Earth, water, fire, wind, space, mind and intellect, ego, light, the world and the orb of the worlds,।

verses.sanskrit: नाशो जन्म च सत्यं च पुण्यपापजयादिकम् । रागः कामः क्रोधलोभौ ध्यानं ध्येयं गुणं परम्
verses.transliteration: nāśo janma ca satyaṃ ca puṇyapāpajayādikam | rāgaḥ kāmaḥ krodhalobhau dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ guṇaṃ param
verses.translation: destruction and birth, truth, merit, sin, victory and the like, passion, desire, anger, greed, meditation, the object of meditation, the highest quality,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: destruction and birth, truth, merit, sin, victory and the like, passion, desire, anger, greed, ध्यान/उपासना, the object of ध्यान/उपासना, the highest quality,।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुशिष्योपदेशादिरादिरन्तं शमं शुभम् । भूतं भव्यं वर्तमानं लक्ष्यं लक्षणमद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: guruśiṣyopadeśādirādirantaṃ śamaṃ śubham | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vartamānaṃ lakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇamadvayam
verses.translation: teaching of teacher and disciple and the like, beginning, end, peace, auspiciousness; past, future, present, aim, mark, non-duality;
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: teaching of teacher and disciple and the like, beginning, end, peace, auspiciousness; past, future, present, aim, mark, non-duality;।

verses.sanskrit: शमो विचारः सन्तोषो भोक्तृभोज्यादिरूपकम् । यमाद्यष्टाङ्गयोगं च गमनागमनात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: śamo vicāraḥ santoṣo bhoktṛbhojyādirūpakam | yamādyaṣṭāṅgayogaṃ ca gamanāgamanātmakam
verses.translation: peace, inquiry, contentment, forms such as enjoyer and enjoyed, the eight-limbed yoga beginning with Yama, of the nature of going and coming,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: peace, inquiry, contentment, forms such as enjoyer and enjoyed, the eight-limbed yoga beginning with Yama, of the nature of going and coming,।

verses.sanskrit: आदिमध्यान्तरङ्गं च ग्राह्यं त्याज्यं हरिः शिवः । इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव अवस्थात्रितयं तथा
verses.transliteration: ādimadhyāntaraṅgaṃ ca grāhyaṃ tyājyaṃ hariḥ śivaḥ | indriyāṇi manaścaiva avasthātritayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: beginning, middle and inner limb, the graspable, the abandonable, Hari, Shiva, the senses and mind, and the three states likewise,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: beginning, middle and inner limb, the graspable, the abandonable, Hari, Shiva, इन्द्रियाँ and mind, and the three states likewise,।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वं च साधनानां चतुष्टयम् । सजातीयं विजातीयं लोका भूरादयः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśatitattvaṃ ca sādhanānāṃ catuṣṭayam | sajātīyaṃ vijātīyaṃ lokā bhūrādayaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: the twenty-four principles, the fourfold means, same-kind and different-kind, the worlds beginning with Bhu in order,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the twenty-four principles, the fourfold means, same-kind and different-kind, the worlds beginning with Bhu in order,।

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववर्णाश्रमाचारं मन्त्रतन्त्रादिसङ्ग्रहम् । विद्याविद्यादिरूपं च सर्ववेदं जडाजडम्
verses.transliteration: sarvavarṇāśramācāraṃ mantratantrādisaṅgraham | vidyāvidyādirūpaṃ ca sarvavedaṃ jaḍājaḍam
verses.translation: the conduct of all castes and stages of life, the collections of mantras, tantras and the like, the forms of knowledge and ignorance, all the Vedas, the dull and the non-dull,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the conduct of all castes and stages of life, the collections of mantras, tantras and the like, the forms of ज्ञान and अविद्या, all the Vedas, the dull and the non-dull,।

verses.sanskrit: बन्धमोक्षविभागं च ज्ञानविज्ञानरूपकम् । बोधाबोधस्वरूपं वा द्वैताद्वैतादिभाषणम्
verses.transliteration: bandhamokṣavibhāgaṃ ca jñānavijñānarūpakam | bodhābodhasvarūpaṃ vā dvaitādvaitādibhāṣaṇam
verses.translation: the division of bondage and liberation, the forms of knowledge and wisdom, the nature of awakening and non-awakening, the talk of duality and non-duality,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the division of bondage and मोक्ष, the forms of ज्ञान and wisdom, the nature of awakening and non-awakening, the talk of duality and non-duality,।

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववेदान्तसिद्धान्तं सर्वशास्त्रार्थनिर्णयम् । अनेकजीवसद्भावमेकजीवादिनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvavedāntasiddhāntaṃ sarvaśāstrārthanirṇayam | anekajīvasadbhāvamekajīvādinirṇayam
verses.translation: the conclusion of all Vedanta, the determination of the meaning of all scriptures, the existence of many individuals, the decision of one individual and the like,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the conclusion of all Vedanta, the determination of the meaning of all scriptures, the existence of many individuals, the decision of one individual and the like,।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यद्ध्यायति चित्तेन यद्यत्सङ्कल्पते क्वचित् । बुद्ध्या निश्चीयते यद्यद्गुरुणा संशृणोति यत्
verses.transliteration: yadyaddhyāyati cittena yadyatsaṅkalpate kvacit | buddhyā niścīyate yadyadguruṇā saṃśṛṇoti yat
verses.translation: whatever one meditates on with the mind, whatever one intends anywhere, whatever the intellect determines, whatever one hears from the teacher,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever one meditates on with मन, whatever one intends anywhere, whatever बुद्धि determines, whatever one hears from गुरुदेव,।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यद्वाचा व्याकरोति यद्यदाचार्यभाषणम् । यद्यत्स्वरेन्द्रियैर्भाव्यं यद्यन्मीमांसते पृथक्
verses.transliteration: yadyadvācā vyākaroti yadyadācāryabhāṣaṇam | yadyatsvarendriyairbhāvyaṃ yadyanmīmāṃsate pṛthak
verses.translation: whatever one explains by speech, whatever the teacher says, whatever is contemplated by the senses, whatever is considered separately,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever one explains by speech, whatever गुरुदेव says, whatever is contemplated by इन्द्रियाँ, whatever is considered separately,।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यन्न्यायेन निर्णीतं महद्भिर्वेदपारगैः । शिवः क्षरति लोकान्वै विष्णुः पाति जगत्त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: yadyannyāyena nirṇītaṃ mahadbhirvedapāragaiḥ | śivaḥ kṣarati lokānvai viṣṇuḥ pāti jagattrayam
verses.translation: whatever is decided by reasoning by the great who have mastered the Vedas — Shiva dissolves the worlds; Vishnu protects the three worlds;
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is decided by reasoning by the great who have mastered the Vedas — Shiva dissolves the worlds; Vishnu protects the three worlds;।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा सृजति लोकान्वै एवमादिक्रियादिकम् । यद्यदस्ति पुराणेषु यद्यद्वेदेषु निर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: brahmā sṛjati lokānvai evamādikriyādikam | yadyadasti purāṇeṣu yadyadvedeṣu nirṇayam
verses.translation: Brahma creates the worlds, and so on with actions like these; whatever is in the Puranas, whatever is determined in the Vedas,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Brahma creates the worlds, and so on with actions like these; whatever is in the Puranas, whatever is determined in the Vedas,।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपनिषदां भावं सर्वं शशविषाणवत् । देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पं तदन्तःकरणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvopaniṣadāṃ bhāvaṃ sarvaṃ śaśaviṣāṇavat | deho'hamiti saṅkalpaṃ tadantaḥkaraṇaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: the sense of all Upanishads — all is like a hare's horn. The intention "I am the body" is called the inner instrument.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the sense of all Upanishads — all is like a hare's horn. The intention "I am शरीर" कहलाता है the inner instrument.।

verses.sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पो महत्संसार उच्यते । देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पस्तद्बन्धमिति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: deho'hamiti saṅkalpo mahatsaṃsāra ucyate | deho'hamiti saṅkalpastadbandhamiti cocyate
verses.translation: The intention "I am the body" is called the great world; the intention "I am the body" is also called bondage.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" कहलाता है the great world; the intention "I am शरीर" is also called bondage.।

verses.sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पस्तद्दुःखमिति चोच्यते । देहोऽहमिति यद्भानं तदेव नरकं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: deho'hamiti saṅkalpastadduḥkhamiti cocyate | deho'hamiti yadbhānaṃ tadeva narakaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The intention "I am the body" is called sorrow; the appearance "I am the body" is remembered as hell.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" कहलाता है sorrow; the appearance "I am शरीर" is remembered as hell.।

verses.sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पो जगत्सर्वमितीर्यते । देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पो हृदयग्रन्थिरीरितिः
verses.transliteration: deho'hamiti saṅkalpo jagatsarvamitīryate | deho'hamiti saṅkalpo hṛdayagranthirīritiḥ
verses.translation: The intention "I am the body" is declared the whole world; the intention "I am the body" is called the knot of the heart.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" is declared the whole world; the intention "I am शरीर" कहलाता है the knot of हृदय-गुहा.।

verses.sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति यज्ज्ञानं तदेवाज्ञानमुच्यते । देहोऽहमिति यज्ज्ञानं तदसद्भावमेव च
verses.transliteration: deho'hamiti yajjñānaṃ tadevājñānamucyate | deho'hamiti yajjñānaṃ tadasadbhāvameva ca
verses.translation: The knowledge "I am the body" is called ignorance; the knowledge "I am the body" is also non-being.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The ज्ञान "I am शरीर" कहलाता है अविद्या; the ज्ञान "I am शरीर" is also non-being.।

verses.sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति या बुद्धिः सा चाविद्येति भण्यते । देहोऽहमिति यज्ज्ञानं तदेव द्वैतमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: deho'hamiti yā buddhiḥ sā cāvidyeti bhaṇyate | deho'hamiti yajjñānaṃ tadeva dvaitamucyate
verses.translation: The intellect "I am the body" is called nescience; the knowledge "I am the body" is called duality.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: बुद्धि "I am शरीर" कहलाता है nescience; the ज्ञान "I am शरीर" कहलाता है duality.।

verses.sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पः सत्यजीवः स एव हि । देहोऽहमिति यज्ज्ञानं परिच्छिन्नमितीरितम्
verses.transliteration: deho'hamiti saṅkalpaḥ satyajīvaḥ sa eva hi | deho'hamiti yajjñānaṃ paricchinnamitīritam
verses.translation: The intention "I am the body" is the real individual; the knowledge "I am the body" is said to be limited.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" is the real individual; the ज्ञान "I am शरीर" is कहा to be limited.।

verses.sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पो महापापमिति स्फुटम् । देहोऽहमिति या बुद्धिस्तृष्णा दोषामयः किल
verses.transliteration: deho'hamiti saṅkalpo mahāpāpamiti sphuṭam | deho'hamiti yā buddhistṛṣṇā doṣāmayaḥ kila
verses.translation: The intention "I am the body" is clearly a great sin; the intellect "I am the body" is craving, a disease of faults.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" is clearly a great sin; बुद्धि "I am शरीर" is craving, a disease of faults.।

verses.sanskrit: यत्किञ्चिदपि सङ्कल्पस्तापत्रयमितीरितम् । कामं क्रोधं बन्धनं सर्वदुःखं विश्वं दोषं कालनानास्वरूपम् । यत्किञ्चेदं सर्वसङ्कल्पजालं तत्किञ्चेदं मानसं सोम विद्धि
verses.transliteration: yatkiñcidapi saṅkalpastāpatrayamitīritam | kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bandhanaṃ sarvaduḥkhaṃ viśvaṃ doṣaṃ kālanānāsvarūpam | yatkiñcedaṃ sarvasaṅkalpajālaṃ tatkiñcedaṃ mānasaṃ soma viddhi
verses.translation: Any intention at all is said to be the threefold affliction. Desire, anger, bondage, all sorrow, the world, fault, the forms of time in many ways — whatever this net of all intentions is, know it, Soma, as mental.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Any intention at all is कहा to be the threefold affliction. Desire, anger, bondage, all sorrow, the world, fault, the forms of time in many ways — whatever this net of all intentions is, know it, Soma, as mental.।

verses.sanskrit: मन एव जगत्सर्वं मन एव महारिपुः । मन एव हि संसारो मन एव जगत्त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: mana eva jagatsarvaṃ mana eva mahāripuḥ | mana eva hi saṃsāro mana eva jagattrayam
verses.translation: The mind alone is all the world; the mind alone is the great enemy; the mind alone is the world; the mind alone is the three worlds.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is all the world; मन alone is the great enemy; मन alone is the world; मन alone is the three worlds.।

verses.sanskrit: मन एव महद्दुःखं मन एव जरादिकम् । मन एव हि कालश्च मन एव मलं तथा
verses.transliteration: mana eva mahadduḥkhaṃ mana eva jarādikam | mana eva hi kālaśca mana eva malaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The mind alone is great sorrow; the mind alone is old age and the like; the mind alone is time; the mind alone is likewise stain.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is great sorrow; मन alone is old age and the like; मन alone is time; मन alone is likewise stain.।

verses.sanskrit: मन एव हि सङ्कल्पो मन एव हि जीवकः । मन एव हि चित्तं च मनोऽहङ्कार एव च
verses.transliteration: mana eva hi saṅkalpo mana eva hi jīvakaḥ | mana eva hi cittaṃ ca mano'haṅkāra eva ca
verses.translation: The mind alone is intention; the mind alone is the individual; the mind alone is thought, and the mind alone is ego.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is intention; मन alone is the individual; मन alone is thought, and मन alone is ego.।

verses.sanskrit: मन एव महद्बन्धं मनोऽन्तःकरणं च तत् । मन एव हि भूमिश्च मन एव हि तोयकम्
verses.transliteration: mana eva mahadbandhaṃ mano'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ ca tat | mana eva hi bhūmiśca mana eva hi toyakam
verses.translation: The mind alone is great bondage; the mind is the inner instrument; the mind alone is earth; the mind alone is water.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is great bondage; मन is the inner instrument; मन alone is earth; मन alone is water.।

verses.sanskrit: मन एव हि तेजश्च मन एव मरुन्महान् । मन एव हि चाकाशं मन एव हि शब्दकम्
verses.transliteration: mana eva hi tejaśca mana eva marunmahān | mana eva hi cākāśaṃ mana eva hi śabdakam
verses.translation: The mind alone is fire; the mind alone is the great wind; the mind alone is space; the mind alone is sound.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is fire; मन alone is the great wind; मन alone is space; मन alone is sound.।

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्शं रूपं रसं गन्धं कोशाः पञ्च मनोभवाः । जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्त्यादि मनोमयरितीरितम्
verses.transliteration: sparśaṃ rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ kośāḥ pañca manobhavāḥ | jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādi manomayaritīritam
verses.translation: Touch, form, taste, smell, the five sheaths are born of the mind; waking, dream, deep sleep and the rest are said to be made of mind.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Touch, form, taste, smell, the five sheaths are born of मन; waking, dream, deep sleep and the rest are कहा to be made of mind.।

verses.sanskrit: दिक्पाला वसवो रुद्रा आदित्याश्च मनोमयाः । दृश्यं जडं द्वन्द्वजातमज्ञानं मानसं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: dikpālā vasavo rudrā ādityāśca manomayāḥ | dṛśyaṃ jaḍaṃ dvandvajātamajñānaṃ mānasaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The guardians of the quarters, Vasus, Rudras and Adityas are made of mind; the seen, the dull, the pairs of opposites, ignorance, are held to be mental.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The guardians of the quarters, Vasus, Rudras and Adityas are made of mind; the seen, the dull, the pairs of opposites, अविद्या, are held to be mental.।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्पमेव यत्किञ्चित्तत्तन्नास्तीति निश्चिनु । नास्ति नास्ति जगत्सर्वं गुरुशिष्यादिकं नहीत्युपनिषत्
verses.transliteration: saṅkalpameva yatkiñcittattannāstīti niścinu | nāsti nāsti jagatsarvaṃ guruśiṣyādikaṃ nahītyupaniṣat
verses.translation: Whatever is mere intention — be certain it does not exist. The whole world does not exist, does not exist; teacher and disciple and the rest do not exist — thus the Upanishad.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is mere intention — be certain it does not exist. The whole world does not exist, does not exist; teacher and disciple and the rest do not exist — thus the Upanishad.।

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुः ॥ सर्वं सच्चिन्मयं विद्धि सर्वं सच्चिन्मयं ततम् । सच्चिदानन्दमद्वैतं सच्चिदानन्दमद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: ṛbhuḥ || sarvaṃ saccinmayaṃ viddhi sarvaṃ saccinmayaṃ tatam | saccidānandamadvaitaṃ saccidānandamadvayam
verses.translation: Ribhu said: Know all as being-consciousness; all is spread out as being-consciousness; being-consciousness-bliss, non-dual; being-consciousness-bliss, without a second.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Ribhu कहा: Know all as being-चैतन्य; all is spread out as being-चैतन्य; being-चैतन्य-bliss, non-dual; being-चैतन्य-bliss, without a second.।

verses.sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दमात्रं हि सच्चिदानन्दमन्यकम् । सच्चिदानन्दरूपोऽहं सच्चिदानन्दमेव खम्
verses.transliteration: saccidānandamātraṃ hi saccidānandamanyakam | saccidānandarūpo'haṃ saccidānandameva kham
verses.translation: Mere being-consciousness-bliss, being-consciousness-bliss and nothing else; I am of the form of being-consciousness-bliss; space itself is being-consciousness-bliss.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mere being-चैतन्य-bliss, being-चैतन्य-bliss and nothing else; I am of the form of being-चैतन्य-bliss; space itself is being-चैतन्य-bliss.।

verses.sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दमेव त्वं सच्चिदानन्दकोऽस्म्यहम् । मनोबुद्धिरहङ्कारचित्तसङ्घातका अमी
verses.transliteration: saccidānandameva tvaṃ saccidānandako'smyaham | manobuddhirahaṅkāracittasaṅghātakā amī
verses.translation: You are being-consciousness-bliss alone; I am being-consciousness-bliss; these combinations of mind, intellect, ego and thought —
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are being-चैतन्य-bliss alone; I am being-चैतन्य-bliss; these combinations of mind, intellect, ego and thought —।

verses.sanskrit: न त्वं नाहं न चान्यद्वा सर्वं ब्रह्मैव केवलम् । न वाक्यं न पदं वेदं नाक्षरं न जडं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: na tvaṃ nāhaṃ na cānyadvā sarvaṃ brahmaiva kevalam | na vākyaṃ na padaṃ vedaṃ nākṣaraṃ na jaḍaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: not you, not I, nor anything else: all is only Brahman alone. No sentence, no word, no Veda, no syllable, nothing dull anywhere.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: not you, not I, nor anything else: all is only परब्रह्म alone. No sentence, no word, no Veda, no syllable, nothing dull anywhere.।

verses.sanskrit: न मध्यं नादि नान्तं वा न सत्यं न निबन्धजम् । न दुःखं न सुखं भावं न माया प्रकृतिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: na madhyaṃ nādi nāntaṃ vā na satyaṃ na nibandhajam | na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ bhāvaṃ na māyā prakṛtistathā
verses.translation: Neither middle, nor beginning, nor end; neither truth nor born of bondage; neither sorrow nor pleasure nor state; neither illusion nor nature.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Neither middle, nor beginning, nor end; neither truth nor born of bondage; neither sorrow nor pleasure nor state; neither illusion nor nature.।

verses.sanskrit: न देहं न मुखं घ्राणं न जिह्वा न च तालुनी । न दन्तोष्ठौ ललाटं च निश्वासोच्छ्वास एव च
verses.transliteration: na dehaṃ na mukhaṃ ghrāṇaṃ na jihvā na ca tālunī | na dantoṣṭhau lalāṭaṃ ca niśvāsocchvāsa eva ca
verses.translation: No body, no face, no nose, no tongue, no palate; no teeth, lips, forehead, nor inhalation and exhalation.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No body, no face, no nose, no tongue, no palate; no teeth, lips, forehead, nor inhalation and exhalation.।

verses.sanskrit: न स्वेदमस्थि मांसं च न रक्तं न च मूत्रकम् । न दूरं नान्तिकं नाङ्गं नोदरं न किरीटकम्
verses.transliteration: na svedamasthi māṃsaṃ ca na raktaṃ na ca mūtrakam | na dūraṃ nāntikaṃ nāṅgaṃ nodaraṃ na kirīṭakam
verses.translation: No sweat, bone, flesh, no blood, no urine; no far, no near, no limb, no belly, no crown.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No sweat, bone, flesh, no blood, no urine; no far, no near, no limb, no belly, no crown.।

verses.sanskrit: न हस्तपादचलनं न शास्त्रं न च शासनम् । न वेत्ता वेदनं वेद्यं न जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुप्तयः
verses.transliteration: na hastapādacalanaṃ na śāstraṃ na ca śāsanam | na vettā vedanaṃ vedyaṃ na jāgratsvapnasuptayaḥ
verses.translation: No moving of hands and feet, no scripture, no command; no knower, knowing or known; no waking, dream or sleep.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No moving of hands and feet, no scripture, no command; no knower, knowing or known; no waking, dream or sleep.।

verses.sanskrit: तुर्यातीतं न मे किञ्चित्सर्वं सच्चिन्मयं ततम् । नाध्यात्मिकं नाधिभूतं नाधिदैवं न मायिकम्
verses.transliteration: turyātītaṃ na me kiñcitsarvaṃ saccinmayaṃ tatam | nādhyātmikaṃ nādhibhūtaṃ nādhidaivaṃ na māyikam
verses.translation: Nothing of mine is beyond the Fourth; all is spread as being-consciousness. Not the individual, not the elemental, not the divine, not the illusory.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Nothing of mine is beyond the Fourth; all is spread as being-चैतन्य. Not the individual, not the elemental, not the divine, not the illusory.।

verses.sanskrit: न विश्वतैजसः प्राज्ञो विराट्सूत्रात्मकेश्वरः । न गमागमचेष्टा च न नष्टं न प्रयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: na viśvataijasaḥ prājño virāṭsūtrātmakeśvaraḥ | na gamāgamaceṣṭā ca na naṣṭaṃ na prayojanam
verses.translation: Not Vishva, Taijasa, Prajna; not Virat, Sutra, Ishvara; no striving of coming and going, no loss, no purpose.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Not Vishva, Taijasa, Prajna; not Virat, Sutra, Ishvara; no striving of coming and going, no loss, no purpose.।

verses.sanskrit: त्याज्यं ग्राह्यं न दूष्यं वा ह्यमेध्यामेध्यकं तथा । न पीनं न कृशं क्लेदं न कालं देशभाषणम्
verses.transliteration: tyājyaṃ grāhyaṃ na dūṣyaṃ vā hyamedhyāmedhyakaṃ tathā | na pīnaṃ na kṛśaṃ kledaṃ na kālaṃ deśabhāṣaṇam
verses.translation: No abandonment, no grasping, no fault; no impure or pure; not fat, not thin, not wet; not time, not speech of place.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No abandonment, no grasping, no fault; no impure or pure; not fat, not thin, not wet; not time, not speech of place.।

verses.sanskrit: न सर्वं न भयं द्वैतं न वृक्षतृणपर्वताः । न ध्यानं योगसंसिद्धिर्न ब्रह्मवैश्यक्षत्रकम्
verses.transliteration: na sarvaṃ na bhayaṃ dvaitaṃ na vṛkṣatṛṇaparvatāḥ | na dhyānaṃ yogasaṃsiddhirna brahmavaiśyakṣatrakam
verses.translation: Not all, not fear, not duality; not trees, grasses or mountains; not meditation, nor accomplishment of yoga; not Brahmin, Vaishya or Kshatriya.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Not all, not fear, not duality; not trees, grasses or mountains; not ध्यान/उपासना, nor accomplishment of yoga; not Brahmin, Vaishya or Kshatriya.।

verses.sanskrit: न पक्षी न मृगो नाङ्गी न लोभो मोह एव च । न मदो न च मात्सर्यं कामक्रोधादयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: na pakṣī na mṛgo nāṅgī na lobho moha eva ca | na mado na ca mātsaryaṃ kāmakrodhādayastathā
verses.translation: No bird, no beast, no embodied, no greed, no delusion; no pride, no envy, no desire, anger and the rest.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No bird, no beast, no embodied, no greed, no delusion; no pride, no envy, no desire, anger and the rest.।

verses.sanskrit: न स्त्रीशूद्रबिडालादि भक्ष्यभोज्यादिकं च यत् । न प्रौढहीनो नास्तिक्यं न वार्तावसरोऽति हि
verses.transliteration: na strīśūdrabiḍālādi bhakṣyabhojyādikaṃ ca yat | na prauḍhahīno nāstikyaṃ na vārtāvasaro'ti hi
verses.translation: No woman, Shudra, cat and so on; no food or what is eaten; no mature or lacking, no atheism, no occasion for talk.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No woman, Shudra, cat and so on; no food or what is eaten; no mature or lacking, no atheism, no occasion for talk.।

verses.sanskrit: न लौकिको न लोको वा न व्यापारो न मूढता । न भोक्ता भोजनं भोज्यं न पात्रं पानपेयकम्
verses.transliteration: na laukiko na loko vā na vyāpāro na mūḍhatā | na bhoktā bhojanaṃ bhojyaṃ na pātraṃ pānapeyakam
verses.translation: No worldly, no world, no business, no foolishness; no enjoyer, meal or food; no vessel, drink or drinkable.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No worldly, no world, no business, no foolishness; no enjoyer, meal or food; no vessel, drink or drinkable.।

verses.sanskrit: न शत्रुमित्रपुत्रादिर्न माता न पिता स्वसा । न जन्म न मृतिर्वृद्धिर्न देहोऽहमिति भ्रमः
verses.transliteration: na śatrumitraputrādirna mātā na pitā svasā | na janma na mṛtirvṛddhirna deho'hamiti bhramaḥ
verses.translation: No enemy, friend, son and so on; no mother, father, sister; no birth, death, growth; no delusion "I am the body."
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No enemy, friend, son and so on; no mother, father, sister; no birth, death, growth; no delusion "I am शरीर.।

verses.sanskrit: न शून्यं नापि चाशून्यं नान्तःकरणसंसृतिः । न रात्रिर्न दिवा नक्तं न ब्रह्मा न हरिः शिवः
verses.transliteration: na śūnyaṃ nāpi cāśūnyaṃ nāntaḥkaraṇasaṃsṛtiḥ | na rātrirna divā naktaṃ na brahmā na hariḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Neither void nor non-void; not the cycle of the inner instrument; no night, no day, no evening; no Brahma, Hari, Shiva.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Neither void nor non-void; not the cycle of the inner instrument; no night, no day, no evening; no Brahma, Hari, Shiva.।

verses.sanskrit: न वारपक्षमासादि वत्सरं न च चञ्चलम् । न ब्रह्मलोको वैकुण्ठो न कैलासो न चान्यकः
verses.transliteration: na vārapakṣamāsādi vatsaraṃ na ca cañcalam | na brahmaloko vaikuṇṭho na kailāso na cānyakaḥ
verses.translation: No weekday, fortnight, month and the like, nor year, nor flickering; no Brahmaloka, Vaikuntha, Kailasa or other.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No weekday, fortnight, month and the like, nor year, nor flickering; no Brahmaloka, Vaikuntha, Kailasa or other.।

verses.sanskrit: न स्वर्गो न च देवेन्द्रो नाग्निलोको न चाग्निकः । न यमो यमलोको वा न लोका लोकपालकाः
verses.transliteration: na svargo na ca devendro nāgniloko na cāgnikaḥ | na yamo yamaloko vā na lokā lokapālakāḥ
verses.translation: No heaven, no Indra; no world of fire, nor Agni; no Yama or world of Yama; no worlds or guardians of worlds.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No heaven, no Indra; no world of fire, nor Agni; no Yama or world of Yama; no worlds or guardians of worlds.।

verses.sanskrit: न भूर्भुवःस्वस्त्रैलोक्यं न पातालं न भूतलम् । नाविद्या न च विद्या च न माया प्रकृतिर्जडा
verses.transliteration: na bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrailokyaṃ na pātālaṃ na bhūtalam | nāvidyā na ca vidyā ca na māyā prakṛtirjaḍā
verses.translation: No Bhur, Bhuvah, Svah, the three worlds; no underworld or earth; neither ignorance nor knowledge; no dull illusion or nature.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No Bhur, Bhuvah, Svah, the three worlds; no underworld or earth; neither अविद्या nor ज्ञान; no dull illusion or nature.।

verses.sanskrit: न स्थिरं क्षणिकं नाशं न गतिर्न च धावनम् । न ध्यातव्यं न मे ध्यानं न मन्त्रो न जपः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: na sthiraṃ kṣaṇikaṃ nāśaṃ na gatirna ca dhāvanam | na dhyātavyaṃ na me dhyānaṃ na mantro na japaḥ kvacit
verses.translation: No steady, no momentary, no destruction; no going, no running; nothing to be meditated on, no meditation of mine, no mantra, no repetition anywhere.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No steady, no momentary, no destruction; no going, no running; nothing to be meditated on, no ध्यान/उपासना of mine, no mantra, no repetition anywhere.।

verses.sanskrit: न पदार्था न पूजार्हं नाभिषेको न चार्चनम् । न पुष्पं न फलं पत्रं गन्धपुष्पादिधूपकम्
verses.transliteration: na padārthā na pūjārhaṃ nābhiṣeko na cārcanam | na puṣpaṃ na phalaṃ patraṃ gandhapuṣpādidhūpakam
verses.translation: No objects, no one worthy of worship, no anointing, no worship; no flower, fruit, leaf, perfume, incense.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No objects, no one worthy of worship, no anointing, no worship; no flower, fruit, leaf, perfume, incense.।

verses.sanskrit: न स्तोत्रं न नमस्कारो न प्रदक्षिणमण्वपि । न प्रार्थना पृथग्भावो न हविर्नाग्निवन्दनम्
verses.transliteration: na stotraṃ na namaskāro na pradakṣiṇamaṇvapi | na prārthanā pṛthagbhāvo na havirnāgnivandanam
verses.translation: No hymn, no salutation, not even an atom of circumambulation; no prayer, no separateness, no oblation, no salutation to fire.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No hymn, no salutation, not even an atom of circumambulation; no prayer, no separateness, no oblation, no salutation to fire.।

verses.sanskrit: न होमो न च कर्माणि न दुर्वाक्यं सुभाषणम् । न गायत्री न वा सन्धिर्न मनस्यं न दुःस्थितिः
verses.transliteration: na homo na ca karmāṇi na durvākyaṃ subhāṣaṇam | na gāyatrī na vā sandhirna manasyaṃ na duḥsthitiḥ
verses.translation: No oblation, no rites; no ill speech or good speech; no Gayatri, no twilight; no mind-state, no ill-state.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No oblation, no rites; no ill speech or good speech; no Gayatri, no twilight; no mind-state, no ill-state.।

verses.sanskrit: न दुराशा न दुष्टात्मा न चाण्डालो न पौल्कसः । न दुःसहं दुरालापं न किरातो न कैतवम्
verses.transliteration: na durāśā na duṣṭātmā na cāṇḍālo na paulkasaḥ | na duḥsahaṃ durālāpaṃ na kirāto na kaitavam
verses.translation: No bad hope, no wicked soul, no Chandala, no Pulkasa; no unbearable, no ill talk, no Kirata, no deceit.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No bad hope, no wicked soul, no Chandala, no Pulkasa; no unbearable, no ill talk, no Kirata, no deceit.।

verses.sanskrit: न पक्षपातं न पक्षं वा न विभूषणतस्करौ । न च दम्भो दाम्भिको वा न हीनो नाधिको नरः
verses.transliteration: na pakṣapātaṃ na pakṣaṃ vā na vibhūṣaṇataskarau | na ca dambho dāmbhiko vā na hīno nādhiko naraḥ
verses.translation: No partiality or party; no ornament or thief; no pride or proud; no low or high man.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No partiality or party; no ornament or thief; no pride or proud; no low or high man.।

verses.sanskrit: नैकं द्वयं त्रयं तुर्यं न महत्वं न चाल्पता । न पूर्णं न परिच्छिन्नं न काशी न व्रतं तपः
verses.transliteration: naikaṃ dvayaṃ trayaṃ turyaṃ na mahatvaṃ na cālpatā | na pūrṇaṃ na paricchinnaṃ na kāśī na vrataṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: Not one, two, three, four; no greatness, no smallness; not full, not limited; no Kashi, no vow, no austerity.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Not one, two, three, four; no greatness, no smallness; not full, not limited; no Kashi, no vow, no तपस्या.।

verses.sanskrit: न गोत्रं न कुलं सूत्रं न विभुत्वं न शून्यता । न स्त्री न योषिन्नो वृद्धा न कन्या न वितन्तुता
verses.transliteration: na gotraṃ na kulaṃ sūtraṃ na vibhutvaṃ na śūnyatā | na strī na yoṣinno vṛddhā na kanyā na vitantutā
verses.translation: No lineage, family, thread; no all-pervasiveness, no emptiness; no woman, no girl, no old woman, no maiden, no lack of thread.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No lineage, family, thread; no all-pervasiveness, no emptiness; no woman, no girl, no old woman, no maiden, no lack of thread.।

verses.sanskrit: न सूतकं न जातं वा नान्तर्मुखसुविभ्रमः । न महावाक्यमैक्यं वा नाणिमादिविभूतयः
verses.transliteration: na sūtakaṃ na jātaṃ vā nāntarmukhasuvibhramaḥ | na mahāvākyamaikyaṃ vā nāṇimādivibhūtayaḥ
verses.translation: No impurity of birth or death; no turning inward and illusion; no great saying, no unity, no powers like anima.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No impurity of birth or death; no turning inward and illusion; no great saying, no unity, no powers like anima.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वचैतन्यमात्रत्वात्सर्वदोषः सदा न हि । सर्वं सन्मात्ररूपत्वात्सच्चिदानन्दमात्रकम्
verses.transliteration: sarvacaitanyamātratvātsarvadoṣaḥ sadā na hi | sarvaṃ sanmātrarūpatvātsaccidānandamātrakam
verses.translation: Because all is mere consciousness, there is never any fault; all is of the form of mere being, mere being-consciousness-bliss.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Because all is mere चैतन्य, there is never any fault; all is of the form of mere being, mere being-चैतन्य-bliss.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मैव सर्वं नान्योऽस्ति तदहं तदहं तथा । तदेवाहं तदेवाहं ब्रह्मैवाहं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaiva sarvaṃ nānyo'sti tadahaṃ tadahaṃ tathā | tadevāhaṃ tadevāhaṃ brahmaivāhaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Brahman alone is all; there is no other; I am that, I am that likewise; I am that alone, that alone; I am Brahman, the eternal.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परब्रह्म alone is all; there is no other; I am that, I am that likewise; I am that alone, that alone; I am परब्रह्म, the eternal.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मैवाहं न संसारी ब्रह्मैवाहं न मे मनः । ब्रह्मैवाहं न मे बुद्धिर्ब्रह्मैवाहं न चेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: brahmaivāhaṃ na saṃsārī brahmaivāhaṃ na me manaḥ | brahmaivāhaṃ na me buddhirbrahmaivāhaṃ na cendriyaḥ
verses.translation: I am Brahman, not a worldly being; I am Brahman, not mind; I am Brahman, not intellect; I am Brahman, not senses.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म, not a worldly being; I am परब्रह्म, not mind; I am परब्रह्म, not intellect; I am परब्रह्म, not senses.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मैवाहं न देहोऽहं ब्रह्मैवाहं न गोचरः । ब्रह्मैवाहं न जीवोऽहं ब्रह्मैवाहं न भेदभूः
verses.transliteration: brahmaivāhaṃ na deho'haṃ brahmaivāhaṃ na gocaraḥ | brahmaivāhaṃ na jīvo'haṃ brahmaivāhaṃ na bhedabhūḥ
verses.translation: I am Brahman, not body; I am Brahman, not an object; I am Brahman, not an individual; I am Brahman, not a ground of difference.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म, not body; I am परब्रह्म, not an object; I am परब्रह्म, not an individual; I am परब्रह्म, not a ground of difference.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मैवाहं जडो नाहमहं ब्रह्म न मे मृतिः । ब्रह्मैवाहं न च प्राणो ब्रह्मैवाहं परात्परः
verses.transliteration: brahmaivāhaṃ jaḍo nāhamahaṃ brahma na me mṛtiḥ | brahmaivāhaṃ na ca prāṇo brahmaivāhaṃ parātparaḥ
verses.translation: I am Brahman, not dull; I am Brahman, I have no death; I am Brahman, not breath; I am Brahman, higher than the highest.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म, not dull; I am परब्रह्म, I have no death; I am परब्रह्म, not breath; I am परब्रह्म, higher than the highest.।

verses.sanskrit: इदं ब्रह्म परं ब्रह्म सत्यं ब्रह्म प्रभुर्हि सः । कालो ब्रह्म कला ब्रह्म सुखं ब्रह्म स्वयम्प्रभम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ brahma paraṃ brahma satyaṃ brahma prabhurhi saḥ | kālo brahma kalā brahma sukhaṃ brahma svayamprabham
verses.translation: This is Brahman, supreme Brahman, true Brahman, the lord; time is Brahman, art is Brahman, happiness is Brahman, self-luminous.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This is परब्रह्म, supreme परब्रह्म, true परब्रह्म, the lord; time is परब्रह्म, art is परब्रह्म, happiness is परब्रह्म, self-luminous.।

verses.sanskrit: एकं ब्रह्म द्वयं ब्रह्म मोहो ब्रह्म शमादिकम् । दोषो ब्रह्म गुणो ब्रह्म दमः शान्तं विभुः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ brahma dvayaṃ brahma moho brahma śamādikam | doṣo brahma guṇo brahma damaḥ śāntaṃ vibhuḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: One is Brahman, two are Brahman; delusion is Brahman, and peace and the rest; fault is Brahman, quality is Brahman; self-control, peace, the all-pervading, the lord.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: One is परब्रह्म, two are परब्रह्म; delusion is परब्रह्म, and peace and the rest; fault is परब्रह्म, quality is परब्रह्म; self-control, peace, the all-pervading, the lord.।

verses.sanskrit: लोको ब्रह्म गुरुर्ब्रह्म शिष्यो ब्रह्म सदाशिवः । पूर्वं ब्रह्म परं ब्रह्म शुद्धं ब्रह्म शुभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: loko brahma gururbrahma śiṣyo brahma sadāśivaḥ | pūrvaṃ brahma paraṃ brahma śuddhaṃ brahma śubhāśubham
verses.translation: The world is Brahman, the teacher is Brahman, the disciple is Brahman, Sadashiva; the earlier is Brahman, the supreme is Brahman, the pure is Brahman, the good and bad.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The world is परब्रह्म, गुरुदेव is परब्रह्म, the disciple is परब्रह्म, Sadashiva; the earlier is परब्रह्म, the supreme is परब्रह्म, the pure is परब्रह्म, the good and bad.।

verses.sanskrit: जीव एव सदा ब्रह्म सच्चिदानन्दमस्म्यहम् । सर्वं ब्रह्ममयं प्रोक्तं सर्वं ब्रह्ममयं जगत्
verses.transliteration: jīva eva sadā brahma saccidānandamasmyaham | sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ proktaṃ sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ jagat
verses.translation: The individual is always Brahman; I am being-consciousness-bliss. All is said to be made of Brahman; the world is all made of Brahman.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The individual is always परब्रह्म; I am being-चैतन्य-bliss. All is कहा to be made of परब्रह्म; the world is all made of परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं ब्रह्म न सन्देहः स्वस्मादन्यन्न किञ्चन । सर्वमात्मैव शुद्धात्मा सर्वं चिन्मात्रमद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ brahma na sandehaḥ svasmādanyanna kiñcana | sarvamātmaiva śuddhātmā sarvaṃ cinmātramadvayam
verses.translation: Brahman itself — no doubt; nothing exists apart from oneself; all is the Self, the pure Self; all is non-dual mere consciousness.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परब्रह्म itself — no doubt; nothing exists apart from oneself; all is आत्मा, the pure Self; all is non-dual mere चैतन्य.।

verses.sanskrit: नित्यनिर्मलरूपात्मा ह्यात्मनोऽन्यन्न किञ्चन । अणुमात्रलसद्रूपमणुमात्रमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: nityanirmalarūpātmā hyātmano'nyanna kiñcana | aṇumātralasadrūpamaṇumātramidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: The Self of eternal stainless form; nothing is apart from the Self; this world is a shining form only of an atom's size.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा of eternal stainless form; nothing is apart from आत्मा; this world is a shining form only of an atom's size.।

verses.sanskrit: अणुमात्रं शरीरं वा ह्यणुमात्रमसत्यकम् । अणुमात्रमचिन्त्यं वा चिन्त्यं वा ह्यणुमात्रकम्
verses.transliteration: aṇumātraṃ śarīraṃ vā hyaṇumātramasatyakam | aṇumātramacintyaṃ vā cintyaṃ vā hyaṇumātrakam
verses.translation: The body is only atom-sized; the unreal is atom-sized; the inconceivable or the conceivable is atom-sized.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: शरीर is only atom-sized; the unreal is atom-sized; the inconceivable or the conceivable is atom-sized.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मैव सर्वं चिन्मात्रं ब्रह्ममात्रं जगत्त्रयम् । आनन्दं परमानन्दमन्यत्किञ्चिन्न किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: brahmaiva sarvaṃ cinmātraṃ brahmamātraṃ jagattrayam | ānandaṃ paramānandamanyatkiñcinna kiñcana
verses.translation: Brahman alone is all, mere consciousness; the three worlds are Brahman only; bliss, supreme bliss — nothing else at all.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परब्रह्म alone is all, mere चैतन्य; the three worlds are परब्रह्म only; bliss, supreme bliss — nothing else at all.।

verses.sanskrit: चैतन्यमात्रमोङ्कारं ब्रह्मैव सकलं स्वयम् । अहमेव जगत्सर्वमहमेव परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: caitanyamātramoṅkāraṃ brahmaiva sakalaṃ svayam | ahameva jagatsarvamahameva paraṃ padam
verses.translation: Mere consciousness is Om; Brahman itself is all; I alone am all the world; I alone am the supreme state.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mere चैतन्य is Om; परब्रह्म itself is all; I alone am all the world; I alone am the supreme state.।

verses.sanskrit: अहमेव गुणातीत अहमेव परात्परः । अहमेव परं ब्रह्म अहमेव गुरोर्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: ahameva guṇātīta ahameva parātparaḥ | ahameva paraṃ brahma ahameva gurorguruḥ
verses.translation: I alone am beyond the qualities; I alone am higher than the highest; I alone am supreme Brahman; I alone am the teacher of teachers.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone am beyond the qualities; I alone am higher than the highest; I alone am supreme परब्रह्म; I alone am गुरुदेव of teachers.।

verses.sanskrit: अहमेवाखिलाधार अहमेव सुखात्सुखम् । आत्मनोऽन्यज्जगन्नास्ति आत्मनोऽन्यत्सुखं न च
verses.transliteration: ahamevākhilādhāra ahameva sukhātsukham | ātmano'nyajjagannāsti ātmano'nyatsukhaṃ na ca
verses.translation: I alone am the support of all; I alone am the happiness of happiness; there is no world apart from the Self; no happiness apart from the Self.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone am the support of all; I alone am the happiness of happiness; there is no world apart from आत्मा; no happiness apart from आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनोऽन्या गतिर्नास्ति सर्वमात्ममयं जगत् । आत्मनोऽन्यन्नहि क्वापि आत्मनोऽन्यत्तृणं नहि
verses.transliteration: ātmano'nyā gatirnāsti sarvamātmamayaṃ jagat | ātmano'nyannahi kvāpi ātmano'nyattṛṇaṃ nahi
verses.translation: There is no goal apart from the Self; the whole world is made of the Self; nothing anywhere is apart from the Self; no grass is apart from the Self.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: There is no goal apart from आत्मा; the whole world is made of आत्मा; nothing anywhere is apart from आत्मा; no grass is apart from आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनोऽन्यत्तुषं नास्ति सर्वमात्ममयं जगत् । ब्रह्ममात्रमिदं सर्वं ब्रह्ममात्रमसन्न हि
verses.transliteration: ātmano'nyattuṣaṃ nāsti sarvamātmamayaṃ jagat | brahmamātramidaṃ sarvaṃ brahmamātramasanna hi
verses.translation: There is no husk apart from the Self; the whole world is made of the Self; all this is Brahman only; the unreal is not Brahman only.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: There is no husk apart from आत्मा; the whole world is made of आत्मा; all this is परब्रह्म only; the unreal is not परब्रह्म only.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्ममात्रं श्रुतं सर्वं स्वयं ब्रह्मैव केवलम् । ब्रह्ममात्रं वृतं सर्वं ब्रह्ममात्रं रसं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: brahmamātraṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ svayaṃ brahmaiva kevalam | brahmamātraṃ vṛtaṃ sarvaṃ brahmamātraṃ rasaṃ sukham
verses.translation: All that is heard is Brahman only; oneself is Brahman alone; all that is chosen is Brahman only; the savor, the happiness is Brahman only.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All that is heard is परब्रह्म only; oneself is परब्रह्म alone; all that is chosen is परब्रह्म only; the savor, the happiness is परब्रह्म only.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्ममात्रं चिदाकाशं सच्चिदानन्दमव्ययम् । ब्रह्मणोऽन्यतरन्नास्ति ब्रह्मणोऽन्यज्जगन्न च
verses.transliteration: brahmamātraṃ cidākāśaṃ saccidānandamavyayam | brahmaṇo'nyatarannāsti brahmaṇo'nyajjaganna ca
verses.translation: Only Brahman is the space of consciousness, the imperishable being-consciousness-bliss; nothing is other than Brahman; no world is other than Brahman.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Only परब्रह्म is the space of चैतन्य, the imperishable being-चैतन्य-bliss; nothing is other than परब्रह्म; no world is other than परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणोऽन्यदह नास्ति ब्रह्मणोऽन्यत्फलं नहि । ब्रह्मणोऽन्यत्तृणं नास्ति ब्रह्मणोऽन्यत्पदं नहि
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo'nyadaha nāsti brahmaṇo'nyatphalaṃ nahi | brahmaṇo'nyattṛṇaṃ nāsti brahmaṇo'nyatpadaṃ nahi
verses.translation: Nothing exists apart from Brahman; no fruit is apart from Brahman; no grass is apart from Brahman; no state is apart from Brahman.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Nothing exists apart from परब्रह्म; no fruit is apart from परब्रह्म; no grass is apart from परब्रह्म; no state is apart from परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणोऽन्यद्गुरुर्नास्ति ब्रह्मणोऽन्यमसद्वपुः । ब्रह्मणोऽन्यन्न चाहन्ता त्वत्तेदन्ते नहि क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo'nyadgururnāsti brahmaṇo'nyamasadvapuḥ | brahmaṇo'nyanna cāhantā tvattedante nahi kvacit
verses.translation: No teacher is apart from Brahman; no body is apart from Brahman, unreal; no egoism is apart from Brahman; "you" and "this" are nowhere.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No teacher is apart from परब्रह्म; no body is apart from परब्रह्म, unreal; no egoism is apart from परब्रह्म; "you" and "this" are nowhere.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं ब्रह्मात्मकं विद्धि स्वस्मादन्यन्न किञ्चन । यत्किञ्चिद्दृश्यते लोके यत्किञ्चिद्भाष्यते जनैः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ brahmātmakaṃ viddhi svasmādanyanna kiñcana | yatkiñciddṛśyate loke yatkiñcidbhāṣyate janaiḥ
verses.translation: Know yourself as Brahman-natured; nothing is apart from oneself. Whatever is seen in the world, whatever is spoken by people,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know yourself as परब्रह्म-natured; nothing is apart from oneself. Whatever is seen in the world, whatever is spoken by people,।

verses.sanskrit: यत्किञ्चिद्भुज्यते क्वापि तत्सर्वमसदेव हि । कर्तृभेदं क्रियाभेदं गुणभेदं रसादिकम्
verses.transliteration: yatkiñcidbhujyate kvāpi tatsarvamasadeva hi | kartṛbhedaṃ kriyābhedaṃ guṇabhedaṃ rasādikam
verses.translation: whatever is enjoyed anywhere, all that is unreal indeed. The difference of doer, of action, of quality, of taste and the like,
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is enjoyed anywhere, all that is unreal indeed. The difference of doer, of action, of quality, of taste and the like,।

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गभेदमिदं सर्वमसदेव सदा सुखम् । कालभेदं देशभेदं वस्तुभेदं जयाजयम्
verses.transliteration: liṅgabhedamidaṃ sarvamasadeva sadā sukham | kālabhedaṃ deśabhedaṃ vastubhedaṃ jayājayam
verses.translation: this difference of gender — all this is only unreal; always happiness. Difference of time, of place, of thing, victory and defeat —
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: this difference of gender — all this is only unreal; always happiness. Difference of time, of place, of thing, victory and defeat —।

verses.sanskrit: यद्यद्भेदं च तत्सर्वमसदेव हि केवलम् । असदन्तःकरणकमसदेवेन्द्रियादिकम्
verses.transliteration: yadyadbhedaṃ ca tatsarvamasadeva hi kevalam | asadantaḥkaraṇakamasadevendriyādikam
verses.translation: whatever is difference, all that is only unreal. The inner instrument is unreal; the senses and the rest are only unreal;
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is difference, all that is only unreal. The inner instrument is unreal; इन्द्रियाँ and the rest are only unreal;।

verses.sanskrit: असत्प्राणादिकं सर्वं सङ्घातमसदात्मकम् । असत्यं पञ्चकोशाख्यमसत्यं पञ्च देवताः
verses.transliteration: asatprāṇādikaṃ sarvaṃ saṅghātamasadātmakam | asatyaṃ pañcakośākhyamasatyaṃ pañca devatāḥ
verses.translation: the breath and the rest are all unreal; the aggregate is of unreal nature; the five sheaths so called are unreal; the five deities are unreal;
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the breath and the rest are all unreal; the aggregate is of unreal nature; the five sheaths so called are unreal; the five deities are unreal;।

verses.sanskrit: असत्यं षड्विकारादि असत्यमरिवर्गकम् । असत्यं षडृतुश्चैव असत्यं षड्रसस्तथा
verses.transliteration: asatyaṃ ṣaḍvikārādi asatyamarivargakam | asatyaṃ ṣaḍṛtuścaiva asatyaṃ ṣaḍrasastathā
verses.translation: the six modifications and the like are unreal; the group of six enemies is unreal; the six seasons are unreal; likewise the six tastes are unreal.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the six modifications and the like are unreal; the group of six enemies is unreal; the six seasons are unreal; likewise the six tastes are unreal.।

verses.sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दमात्रोऽहमनुत्पन्नमिदं जगत् । आत्मैवाहं परं सत्यं नान्याः संसारदृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: saccidānandamātro'hamanutpannamidaṃ jagat | ātmaivāhaṃ paraṃ satyaṃ nānyāḥ saṃsāradṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.translation: I am mere being-consciousness-bliss; this world has not arisen. I am the Self alone, the supreme truth; no other views of the world.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am mere being-चैतन्य-bliss; this world has not arisen. I am आत्मा alone, the supreme truth; no other views of the world.।

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमानन्दरूपोऽहं चिद्घनानन्दविग्रहः । अहमेव परानन्द अहमेव परात्परः
verses.transliteration: satyamānandarūpo'haṃ cidghanānandavigrahaḥ | ahameva parānanda ahameva parātparaḥ
verses.translation: I am of the form of true bliss, a body of consciousness and bliss; I alone am supreme bliss; I alone am higher than the highest.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the form of true bliss, a body of चैतन्य and bliss; I alone am supreme bliss; I alone am higher than the highest.।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानाकारमिदं सर्वं ज्ञानानन्दोऽहमद्वयः । सर्वप्रकाशरूपोऽहं सर्वाभावस्वरूपकम्
verses.transliteration: jñānākāramidaṃ sarvaṃ jñānānando'hamadvayaḥ | sarvaprakāśarūpo'haṃ sarvābhāvasvarūpakam
verses.translation: All this is of the form of knowledge; I am knowledge-bliss, non-dual; I am of the form of light of all; I am of the form of the absence of all.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All this is of the form of ज्ञान; I am ज्ञान-bliss, non-dual; I am of the form of light of all; I am of the form of the absence of all.।

verses.sanskrit: अहमेव सदा भामीत्येवं रूपं कुतोऽप्यसत् । त्वमित्येवं परं ब्रह्म चिन्मयानन्दरूपवान्
verses.transliteration: ahameva sadā bhāmītyevaṃ rūpaṃ kuto'pyasat | tvamityevaṃ paraṃ brahma cinmayānandarūpavān
verses.translation: "I alone ever shine" — such a form is unreal from anywhere; "you" — thus supreme Brahman, of the form of consciousness and bliss.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone ever shine" — such a form is unreal from anywhere; "you" — thus supreme परब्रह्म, of the form of चैतन्य and bliss.।

verses.sanskrit: चिदाकारं चिदाकाशं चिदेव परमं सुखम् । आत्मैवाहमसन्नाहं कूटस्थोऽहं गुरुः परः
verses.transliteration: cidākāraṃ cidākāśaṃ cideva paramaṃ sukham | ātmaivāhamasannāhaṃ kūṭastho'haṃ guruḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: Form of consciousness, space of consciousness, consciousness alone is supreme happiness; I am the Self alone, not unreal; I am the immovable witness, the supreme teacher.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Form of चैतन्य, space of चैतन्य, चैतन्य alone is supreme happiness; I am आत्मा alone, not unreal; I am the immovable witness, the supreme teacher.।

verses.sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दमात्रोऽहमनुत्पन्नमिदं जगत् । कालो नास्ति जगन्नास्ति मायाप्रकृतिरेव न
verses.transliteration: saccidānandamātro'hamanutpannamidaṃ jagat | kālo nāsti jagannāsti māyāprakṛtireva na
verses.translation: I am mere being-consciousness-bliss; this world has not arisen. There is no time; there is no world; no illusion or nature at all.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am mere being-चैतन्य-bliss; this world has not arisen. There is no time; there is no world; no illusion or nature at all.।

verses.sanskrit: अहमेव हरिः साक्षादहमेव सदाशिवः । शुद्धचैतन्यभावोऽहं शुद्धसत्त्वानुभावनः
verses.transliteration: ahameva hariḥ sākṣādahameva sadāśivaḥ | śuddhacaitanyabhāvo'haṃ śuddhasattvānubhāvanaḥ
verses.translation: I alone am Hari in person; I alone am Sadashiva; I am of the state of pure consciousness; of the experience of pure sattva.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone am Hari in person; I alone am Sadashiva; I am of the state of pure चैतन्य; of the experience of pure sattva.।

verses.sanskrit: अद्वयानन्दमात्रोऽहं चिद्घनैकरसोऽस्म्यहम् । सर्वं ब्रह्मैव सततं सर्वं ब्रह्मैव केवलम्
verses.transliteration: advayānandamātro'haṃ cidghanaikaraso'smyaham | sarvaṃ brahmaiva satataṃ sarvaṃ brahmaiva kevalam
verses.translation: I am mere non-dual bliss; I am a mass of consciousness of one savor. All is Brahman always; all is Brahman only.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am mere non-dual bliss; I am a mass of चैतन्य of one savor. All is परब्रह्म always; all is परब्रह्म only.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं ब्रह्मैव सततं सर्वं ब्रह्मैव चेतनम् । सर्वान्तर्यामिरूपोऽहं सर्वसाक्षित्वलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ brahmaiva satataṃ sarvaṃ brahmaiva cetanam | sarvāntaryāmirūpo'haṃ sarvasākṣitvalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: All is Brahman always; all is Brahman, conscious. I am of the form of the inner controller of all, marked by being the witness of all.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All is परब्रह्म always; all is परब्रह्म, conscious. I am of the form of the inner controller of all, marked by being the witness of all.।

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मा परं ज्योतिः परं धाम परा गतिः । सर्ववेदान्तसारोऽहं सर्वशास्त्रसुनिश्चितः
verses.transliteration: paramātmā paraṃ jyotiḥ paraṃ dhāma parā gatiḥ | sarvavedāntasāro'haṃ sarvaśāstrasuniścitaḥ
verses.translation: The Supreme Self, the supreme light, the supreme abode, the supreme goal; I am the essence of all Vedanta, well determined by all scriptures.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परमात्मा, the supreme light, the supreme abode, the supreme goal; I am the essence of all Vedanta, well determined by all scriptures.।

verses.sanskrit: योगानन्दस्वरूपोऽहं मुख्यानन्दमहोदयः । सर्वज्ञानप्रकाशोऽस्मि मुख्यविज्ञानविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: yogānandasvarūpo'haṃ mukhyānandamahodayaḥ | sarvajñānaprakāśo'smi mukhyavijñānavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: I am of the nature of the bliss of yoga, the great rise of principal bliss; I am the light of all knowledge, a body of principal wisdom.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the nature of the bliss of yoga, the great rise of principal bliss; I am the light of all ज्ञान, a body of principal wisdom.।

verses.sanskrit: तुर्यातुर्यप्रकाशोऽस्मि तुर्यातुर्यादिवर्जितः । चिदक्ष्रोऽन् सत्योऽहं वासुदवोऽजररोऽमरः
verses.transliteration: turyāturyaprakāśo'smi turyāturyādivarjitaḥ | cidakṣro'n satyo'haṃ vāsudavo'jararo'maraḥ
verses.translation: I am the light of the Fourth of the Fourth, free of the Fourth of the Fourth and the rest; I am the imperishable consciousness, truth; I am Vasudeva, ageless, deathless.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am the light of the Fourth of the Fourth, free of the Fourth of the Fourth and the rest; I am the imperishable चैतन्य, truth; I am Vasudeva, ageless, deathless.।

verses.sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्म चिदाकाशं नित्यं ब्रह्म निरञ्जनम् । शुद्धं बुद्धं सदामुक्तमनामकमरूपकम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ brahma cidākāśaṃ nityaṃ brahma nirañjanam | śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ sadāmuktamanāmakamarūpakam
verses.translation: I am Brahman, the space of consciousness, eternal Brahman, stainless; pure, awake, ever free, nameless, formless.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म, the space of चैतन्य, eternal परब्रह्म, stainless; pure, awake, ever free, nameless, formless.।

verses.sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दरूपोऽहमनुन्त्पन्नमिदं जगत् । सत्यासत्यं जगन्नास्ति सङ्कल्पकलनादिकम्
verses.transliteration: saccidānandarūpo'hamanuntpannamidaṃ jagat | satyāsatyaṃ jagannāsti saṅkalpakalanādikam
verses.translation: I am of the form of being-consciousness-bliss; this world has not arisen. The true and false world does not exist; nor intention, imagining and the like.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the form of being-चैतन्य-bliss; this world has not arisen. The true and false world does not exist; nor intention, imagining and the like.।

verses.sanskrit: नित्यानन्दमयं ब्रह्म केवलं सर्वदा स्वयम् । अनन्तमव्ययं शान्तमेकरूपमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: nityānandamayaṃ brahma kevalaṃ sarvadā svayam | anantamavyayaṃ śāntamekarūpamanāmayam
verses.translation: Brahman is made of eternal bliss, alone, always by itself; infinite, imperishable, peaceful, of one form, free of disease.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परब्रह्म is made of eternal bliss, alone, always by itself; infinite, imperishable, peaceful, of one form, free of disease.।

verses.sanskrit: मत्तोऽन्यदस्ति चेन्मिथ्या यथा मरुमरीचिका । वन्ध्याकुमारवचने भीतिश्चेदस्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: matto'nyadasti cenmithyā yathā marumarīcikā | vandhyākumāravacane bhītiścedasti kiñcana
verses.translation: If anything exists apart from me, it is false, like a mirage in a desert. If there were any fear from the words of a barren woman's son —
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If anything exists apart from me, it is false, like a mirage in a desert. If there were any fear from the words of a barren woman's son —।

verses.sanskrit: शशशृङ्गेण नागेन्द्रो मृतश्चेज्जगदस्ति तत् । मृगतृष्णाजलं पीत्वा तृप्तश्चेदस्त्विदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: śaśaśṛṅgeṇa nāgendro mṛtaścejjagadasti tat | mṛgatṛṣṇājalaṃ pītvā tṛptaścedastvidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: If a king of elephants were killed by a hare's horn, then the world would exist. If one drinking mirage-water were satisfied, let this world be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a king of elephants were killed by a hare's horn, then the world would exist. If one drinking mirage-water were satisfied, let this world be.।

verses.sanskrit: नरशृङ्गेण नष्टश्चेत्कश्चिदस्त्विदमेव हि । गन्धर्वनगरे सत्ये जगद्भवति सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: naraśṛṅgeṇa naṣṭaścetkaścidastvidameva hi | gandharvanagare satye jagadbhavati sarvadā
verses.translation: If anyone were destroyed by a man's horn, then this indeed exists. If the city of Gandharvas were true, the world would always be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If anyone were destroyed by a man's horn, then this indeed exists. If the city of Gandharvas were true, the world would always be.।

verses.sanskrit: गगने नीलिमासत्ये जगत्सत्यं भविष्यति । शुक्तिकारजतं सत्यं भूषणं चेज्जगद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: gagane nīlimāsatye jagatsatyaṃ bhaviṣyati | śuktikārajataṃ satyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ cejjagadbhavet
verses.translation: If the blueness of the sky were true, the world would be true. If the silver in a shell were true as ornament, the world would be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If the blueness of the sky were true, the world would be true. If the silver in a shell were true as ornament, the world would be.।

verses.sanskrit: रज्जुसर्पेण दष्टश्चेन्नरो भवतु संसृतिः । जातरूपेण बाणेन ज्वालाग्नौ नाशिते जगत्
verses.transliteration: rajjusarpeṇa daṣṭaścennaro bhavatu saṃsṛtiḥ | jātarūpeṇa bāṇena jvālāgnau nāśite jagat
verses.translation: If a man bitten by a rope-snake were to be so, let there be the world; if by a golden arrow the flaming fire were destroyed, the world would be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a man bitten by a rope-snake were to be so, let there be the world; if by a golden arrow the flaming fire were destroyed, the world would be.।

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्याटव्यां पायसान्नमस्ति चेज्जगदुद्भवः । रम्भास्तम्भेन काष्ठेन पाकसिद्धौ जगद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vindhyāṭavyāṃ pāyasānnamasti cejjagadudbhavaḥ | rambhāstambhena kāṣṭhena pākasiddhau jagadbhavet
verses.translation: If there were rice-pudding in the Vindhya forest, the world would arise; if by a plantain trunk as fuel cooking succeeded, the world would be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If there were rice-pudding in the Vindhya forest, the world would arise; if by a plantain trunk as fuel cooking succeeded, the world would be.।

verses.sanskrit: सद्यः कुमारिकरूपैः पाके सिद्धे जगद्भवेत् । चित्रस्थदीपैस्तमसो नाशश्चेदस्त्विदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: sadyaḥ kumārikarūpaiḥ pāke siddhe jagadbhavet | citrasthadīpaistamaso nāśaścedastvidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: If cooking succeeded by the forms of newly born girls, the world would be; if darkness were destroyed by lamps in a picture, let this world be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If cooking succeeded by the forms of newly born girls, the world would be; if darkness were destroyed by lamps in a picture, let this world be.।

verses.sanskrit: मासात्पूर्वं मृतो मर्त्यो ह्यागतश्चेज्जगद्भवेत् । तक्रं क्षीरस्वरूपं चेत्क्वचिन्नित्यं जगद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: māsātpūrvaṃ mṛto martyo hyāgataścejjagadbhavet | takraṃ kṣīrasvarūpaṃ cetkvacinnityaṃ jagadbhavet
verses.translation: If a mortal dead a month ago came back, the world would be; if buttermilk were of the nature of milk anywhere, the world would be eternal.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a mortal dead a month ago came back, the world would be; if buttermilk were of the nature of milk anywhere, the world would be eternal.।

verses.sanskrit: गोस्तनादुद्भवं क्षीरं पुनरारोपणे जगत् । भूरजोऽब्धौ समुत्पन्ने जगद्भवतु सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: gostanādudbhavaṃ kṣīraṃ punarāropaṇe jagat | bhūrajo'bdhau samutpanne jagadbhavatu sarvadā
verses.translation: If milk from a cow's udder could be re-planted, the world; if earth-dust arose in the ocean, let the world always be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If milk from a cow's udder could be re-planted, the world; if earth-dust arose in the ocean, let the world always be.।

verses.sanskrit: कूर्मरोम्णा गजे बद्धे जगदस्तु मदोत्कटे । नालस्थतन्तुना मेरुश्चालितश्चेज्जगद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: kūrmaromṇā gaje baddhe jagadastu madotkaṭe | nālasthatantunā meruścālitaścejjagadbhavet
verses.translation: If an elephant in rut were bound by a tortoise's hair, let there be the world; if Meru were moved by a lotus fiber, the world would be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If an elephant in rut were bound by a tortoise's hair, let there be the world; if Meru were moved by a lotus fiber, the world would be.।

verses.sanskrit: तरङ्गमालया सिन्धुर्बद्धश्चेदस्त्विदं जगत् । अग्नेरधश्चेज्ज्वलनं जगद्भवतु सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: taraṅgamālayā sindhurbaddhaścedastvidaṃ jagat | agneradhaścejjvalanaṃ jagadbhavatu sarvadā
verses.translation: If the ocean were bound by a garland of waves, let this world be; if fire were below fire, let the world always be.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If the ocean were bound by a garland of waves, let this world be; if fire were below fire, let the world always be.।

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालावह्निः शीतलश्चेदस्तिरूपमिदं जगत् । ज्वालाग्निमण्डले पद्मवृद्धिश्चेज्जगदस्त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: jvālāvahniḥ śītalaścedastirūpamidaṃ jagat | jvālāgnimaṇḍale padmavṛddhiścejjagadastvidam
verses.translation: If a flame were cold, this form of world would exist; if a lotus grew in a circle of flaming fire, let there be the world.
verses.hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a flame were cold, this form of world would exist; if a lotus grew in a circle of flaming fire, let there be the world.।

verses.sanskrit: महच्छैलेन्द्रनीलं वा सम्भवच्चेदिदं जगत् । मेरुरागत्य पद्माक्षे स्थितश्चेदस्त्विदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: mahacchailendranīlaṃ vā sambhavaccedidaṃ jagat | merurāgatya padmākṣe sthitaścedastvidaṃ jagat
